title: Python bytecode (.pyc) signature
summary: A Python 3.7+ bytecode file begins with a 16-byte header: a 4-byte magic number (version-specific), a 4-byte flags field, a 4-byte timestamp or hash, and a 4-byte source size or hash.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Magic number varies by Python version (e.g., 0xCB0D0DF3 for 3.11).
The marshal module serializes the code object after the header.
pyc files are cached in __pycache__/ directories.
